invariants.description: Ask writeback and Deposit create a pending Review proposal; they do not directly mutate Canonical Wiki.
An invalid Dev Run state transition returns HTTP 409 with a machine-readable code and a non-empty reason.
Repeating the same Deposit payload reuses the existing Review proposal and does not create another side effect.
Vault file paths must be relative to the active Vault root; absolute and escaping paths are rejected.
Without an external model configuration, the deterministic Agent Runtime returns repeatable bounded output.
The context_pack, search, deposit, and health_check MCP tools retain their names and structured validation or domain-error boundaries.
